records.wholeBilingualScienceAndTransferReview: Connected plant cells can be observed and described as a tissue association without requiring unresolvable membranes to be seen. Onion bulb lacks chloroplasts; the leaf example has chloroplasts, and absence from a field of view does not establish universal absence. At 500 micrometres across five cells the mean is 100 micrometres; the independent 180/3 example yields 60 micrometres. Focusing, cropping, thickness and staining are genuine fresh variations; a root preparation cannot be declared chloroplast-free from poor visibility alone.

records.wholeBilingualScienceAndTransferReview: Current fermentation-c1 defines 20 ml liquid, 0.2 g yeast and 2 percent m/V glucose (0.4 g available), temperature 30 degrees C, pressure 1 bar, dry corrected carbon-dioxide gas and 25.2 L/mol. Corrected 80 mmol/L ethanol times 0.020 L is 1.60 mmol; the 1:1 ethanol/carbon-dioxide reaction predicts 40.32 ml. Collected 38 ml is 94.246 percent and differs by 2.32 ml, within the explicit synthetic 90-100 percent collection interval. Triplicate ethanol 1.52/1.60/1.68 mmol predicts 38.304/40.32/42.336 ml versus collected 36/38/40 ml. Required glucose 0.8 mmol corresponds to about 0.144 g, below the available 0.4 g. Glycolysis net ATP is 4 minus 2 equals 2; fermentation regenerates NAD+ without additional ATP. The defined homofermentative lactate case has a 2:1 lactate/glucose ratio and no carbon dioxide; pH alone is not a lactate proof and heterogeneous fermentation can produce gas. Fresh aerated carbon dioxide without ethanol does not prove alcoholic fermentation. All data are declared synthetic; no actual culture or instrument recovery is certified.

records.wholeBilingualScienceAndTransferReview: Aerobic C6H12O6 plus 6 O2 to 6 CO2 plus 6 H2O conserves C6 H12 O18. Alcoholic 2 C2H6O plus 2 CO2 and homolactic 2 C3H6O3 each conserve the starting atoms; physiological lactate/proton notation is separately bounded. The supplied net 30 versus 2 ATP model requires 2 versus 30 glucose for 60 ATP, a 15-fold ratio; fresh 32 versus 2 requires 2 versus 32 for 64 ATP, ratio 16. Four respiration plus six lactate fermentations yield 132 ATP, 24 oxygen, 24 carbon dioxide and 12 lactate. Ten fermentations yield 20 ATP and 20 lactate, without oxygen use even if external oxygen is available when mitochondria are absent. Uncoupling invalidates the fixed aerobic ATP figure and does not automatically establish exclusive fermentation.

records.wholeBilingualScienceAndTransferReview: Equal 10 g food-energy values 170 and 370 kJ give 37/17 about 2.176, a mass-normalized comparison. Palmitic acid C16H32O2 plus 23 O2 to 16 CO2 plus 16 H2O balances 48 oxygen atoms on each side. Seven beta-oxidation NADH times 2.5, seven FADH2 times 1.5, eight acetyl-CoA times 10 minus activation cost 2 yield 106 net ATP. Mass-normalized ATP is 30/180 about 0.1667 versus 106/256 about 0.4141 mol ATP/g, ratio 2.484; this is explicitly distinct from the food-energy ratio 2.18. A stipulated glycogen store 100 g plus 300 g water gives 4.25 kJ/g wet store versus fat 37, ratio about 8.71. Fresh changed coupling gives 83 ATP in the stated model, rather than claiming the palmitate number describes every triglyceride, glycerol or unsaturation state. Higher storage density does not imply faster energy supply.
